edits.old: A database profiling level of zero does not by itself prove Ops Manager Profiler is disabled: project log collection and database profiling are separate controls. The 2024 incident reported working Profiler pages despite level zero. (high confidence)
edits.new: A database profiling level of zero does not by itself prove Ops Manager Profiler is disabled: the Performance Advisor and Profiler project setting does not affect whether the database profiler is enabled; it only controls whether Ops Manager collects and displays slow query data. An April 2024 MongoDB Community forum post reported five replica sets in one project, all with profiling level 0 ("was": 0.0), where the Profiler page worked normally on four of them. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ops-manager/current/tutorial/profile-database.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/ops-manager-profiler-has-no-data/276759
